tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zhing mchog bde ba can du skye bar 'dun pa'i smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa zhing gi bkod pa rab tu gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ /zhing mchog bde ba can du skye bar 'dun pa'i smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa zhing gi bkod pa rab tu gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rgyal ba 'od dpag med la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag /brgyad cu rtsa gcig zhing kun sdom pa las/ /zhing gi bkod pa'i yon tan ches lhag pa'i/ /zhing mchog bde ba can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam dag zhing dbus lha rdzas ljon pa'i shing / /dbyibs legs yid 'ong sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /'gro ba'i re 'dod tshul bzhin skong byed pa'i/ /rin chen byang chub shing la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shing mchog drung na rin chen mdzes pa'i khrir/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo mtshan dpe dpal 'bar ba/ /zhing kun 'od kyis snang bas khyab mdzad pa'i/ /'dren mchog 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /mkhyen rab mnga' bdag mthu chen legs thob pa/ /bde ldan rtag tu 'od kyis gsal mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal sras thu bo gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal chen go bgos seng ge'i sgra dbyangs sgrog /dpag tshad bye ba brgya stong khyab pa'i 'od/ /thogs pa med par lus las 'gyed mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsum rig mngon shes drug ldan nyon mongs med/ /'dom gang 'od 'bar tha ma'i lus 'dzin pa/ /bgrang bas mthar thug rtogs par mi nus pa'i/ /nyan thos dge 'dun rnams la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyad par sa skya'i rje btsun yab sras sogs/ /lung rtogs yon tan dpag med mdzod mnga' ba/ /zhing mchog gang der rim bzhin byon pa yis/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod pa kun 'bul sdig pa thams cad bshags/

/dge la yi rang chos 'khor ma lus bskor/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag tu bzhugs su gsol/ /dus gsum dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo/ /bsod nams 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bsam don kun 'grub bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /rigs brgyud dri med rgyun chad med par shog /'chi ba'i tshe na 'dren pa 'od dpag med/ /dge slong tshogs kyis bskor ba legs mthong nas/ /rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis shi 'phos te/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /lag mthil ltar mnyam rin chen du mas spras/ /'byor zhing bde la legs snyam nyams dga' ba/ /lha mi'i skye bos rtag tu gang ba'i zhing / /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /mi dang lha zhes tha snyad tsam zhig las/ /lus dang longs spyod yon tan khyad par rnams/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed lha dang mtshungs pa'i zhing / /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /lha yi mig dang lha yi rna ba dang / /tshe rabs dran dang gzhan gyi sems shes pa/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs dang rab tu ldan 'gyur ba'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /rgyal bas bskal pa du mar rab brjod kyang / /gang gi yon tan bsngags pa mi zad pa/ /bgrang yas byang chub sems dpa' gang ba'i zhing / /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /stong gsum sems can rang sangs rgyas 'gyur bas/ /bskal mang bye bar bgrangs bar mi dpyod pa'i/ /tshad med nyan thos tshogs kyis gang ba'i zhing / /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /zhing mchog gang du skyes pa'i sems can rnams/ /gal te smon lam dbang gis ma gtogs par/ /tshe yi tshad la bgrang mtha' ma mchis pa'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /rab mkhregs rdo rje lta bu'i lus ldan zhing / /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan gyi go bgos pa/ /sred med bu yi stobs dang mthu thob pa'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog

/snga dro re rer zhing gzhan rab bgrod nas/ /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig mang po la/ /bde bar sbyar ba kun gyis bsnyen bkur ba'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /gser dngul la sogs rin chen thams cad dang / /me tog spos sogs yo byad sna tshogs pa/ /yid la bsam pa tsam gyis 'byung ba'i zhing / /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /so so yang dag rig pa bzhi thob cing / /kun kyang shes rab spobs pa mtha' yas pas/ /theg chen chos kyi bka' mchid bgyid pa'i zhing / /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /der gnas mchod pa'i khyad par sna tshogs pas/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod par 'dod ma thag /brtse bas mchod pa de dag bzhes mdzad pa'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /gang gi lha mig dag pas brtags na yang / /'byor pa'i mtha' nyid shes par mi nus pa'i/ /rgyan gyi bkod pa phun tshogs ldan pa'i zhing / /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /ji ltar shin tu phyis pa'i me long ngos/ /bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor gdab pa de lta bur/ /tshad med zhing kun snang ba'i 'od gsal ba'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /sa yi steng nas bzung ste bar snang las/ /lha mi'i yul las 'das pa'i bdug spos dag /rin chen spos snod dag nas bdug 'gyur ba'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /dri zhim me tog char pa rtag 'bab cing / /rol mo snyan pa'i nga ro yid 'ong ba/ /ngo mtshar sprin gyi sgra dbyangs sgrog ldan pa'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /bde gshegs sku las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /sems can gang la gsal bar gyur ma thag /lha mi'i yul las 'das pa'i bde thob pa'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /chos gos rin chen gsar pa khye 'u tshangs/ /rigs bzang de bzhin gshegs pas gnang ba dag /bsam ma thag tu lus la 'gos 'gyur ba'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog

/ji ltar dgra bcom bsam gtan gsum pa la/ /snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba de lta bu/ /skyes ma thag tu bde blag thob 'gyur ba'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /sangs rgyas zhing gi yon tan rgyan bkod pa/ /rnam pa ji ltar yid la re ba gang / /sna tshogs rin chen shing las tshal 'gyur ba'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /dam chos bstan pa rnam pa ji lta bu/ /mnyan par 'tshal ba'i rnam pa de dag ni/ /sems bskyed mod la thos par 'gyur ba'i zhing / /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /rtsa ba sdong bu yal 'dab me tog 'bras/ /rin chen bdun las grub pa'i dpag bsam shing / /tshar du dngar bas legs par brgyan pa'i zhing / /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /mtha' ma rin chen chu shing sngon po dang / /lha rdzas tā la'i phreng bas yongs bskor cing / /thams cad gser gyi dra bas khebs pa'i zhing / /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /sa phyogs kun tu dpag tshad phyed pa nas/ /dpag tshad bcu yi tshad dang mnyam pa yi/ /rin chen sna bdun padmas khebs pa'i zhing / /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /padma dag las sna tshogs 'od 'byung zhing / /'od zer rtse la rgyal ba'i sku bzhugs nas/ /phyogs bcur 'gro la rtag tu chos ston pa'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /lhun po 'khor yug dang ni khor yug che/ /dug can mtsho dang nag po'i ri med cing / /rin chen ri bo du mas gang ba'i zhing / /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /dri zhim chus gang yid 'ong sgra ldan zhing / /'gram gnyis ljon shing phreng bas legs dkris pa'i/ /sna tshogs chu klung du ma rtag 'bab pa'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /gang dag klung der rtse phyir 'jug pa na/ /che chung bsil drod khyad par du ma dag /bsam pa ji bzhin gnas par 'gyur pa'i zhing / /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog

/chu klung de dag lha shing ta ma la/ /a kar tsandan rgya spos dris bsgos shing / /padma utpa la sogs legs khebs pa'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /sems can gang dag chu klung 'gram der ni/ /zang zing med pa'i dga' bas gnas pa dag /yid la bsam pa thams cad 'grub 'gyur ba'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /ngang pa ne tso ri skeg khu byug sogs/ /bde gshegs sprul pa'i bya tshogs kyis bsten cing / /snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs rtag tu sgrog ldan pa'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /kham zas rags pa dag dang bral ba dang / /ji ltar 'dod pa'i kha zas 'byung 'gyur la/ /tshim zhing lus la 'jug par mi byed pa'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /de tshe lus las ji ltar re ba yi/ /lha rdzas spos kyi dri zhim ngad ldan pas/ /sangs rgyas zhing de ma lus bdug 'gyur ba'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /srab 'jam tshon sna stong gis bgos pa'i gos/ /cod paṇa la sogs rin chen rgyan mang ni/ /thams cad dpag bsam shing las 'byung ba'i zhing / /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /lha ras bcos bu legs bting rin chen khri/ /khra bo'i sngas ldan ba gam stong dag gis/ /rgyan spras gzhal med khang bzang bdun 'byung ba'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /der ni lha yi bu mo bdun stong gis/ /mdun du lta zhing 'dod pa'i longs spyod la/ /brtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod pa'i zhing / /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /rin chen shing las rlung gis rab bsgul te/ /nyin mtshan dus drug lha rdzas me tog dag /mi 'grengs bdun srid legs par 'grem 'gyur ba'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /de dag ka tsa le na ltar 'jam la/ /reg na bde zhing rkang pa 'degs 'jog tshe/ /sor bzhi tsam du mtho dang dmar 'gyur ba'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog

/nyi zla gza' skar mun nag dang bral zhing / /nyin dang mtshan mor gdags pa med pa dang / /khyim yongs 'dzin pa'i 'du shes rab spangs pa'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /lha rdzas bla bre gdugs dang rnga yab sogs/ /rnam pa mang po mkha' la legs 'dzin cing / /lha yi bu mo sna tshogs gar byed pa'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /'dren pa 'od dpag med la phyag bya'i phyir/ /gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed zhing rnams nas/ /bgrang yas byang chub sems dpa' lhags 'gyur ba'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /de dag me tog kha dog tha dad pa/ /dri zhim yid 'ong snyim par legs thogs te/ /rgyal ba'i sku la mngon par mthor byed pa'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /gang tshe me tog snyim pas gtor ma thag /de tshe dpag tshad brgya pa'i gdugs gyur nas/ /'dren pa'i sku la 'khor bar gnas pa yi/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /de tshe 'od dpag med pa'i 'dzum bstan pa'i/ /zhal nas 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig 'phros/ /slar yang rgyal ba'i dbu gtsug nub 'gyur ba'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /spyan ras gzigs kyis de yi rgyu zhus pas/ /'di dag smon lam dbang gis zhing 'dir lhags/ /byang chub phyir mi ldog ces lung ston pa'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /me tog spos dang mar me sil snyan sogs/ /mchod pa'i khyad par gang gis mchod 'dod pa/ /thams cad sangs rgyas mthu las 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /rnam pa ji ltar 'dod bzhin lha rdzas kyi/ /me tog skon bu lags nas byung gyur bas/ /rgyal ba'i sku la mngon du 'thor byed pa'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /gtor ba'i tshe na me tog phyi ma shos/ /ma dor bar du snga ma nam mkha' la/ /me tog gdugs kyi rnam par gnas 'gyur ba'i/ /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog

/de ltar mchod pa'i sprin phung mtha' yas pas/ /sangs rgyas bye ba mang la mchod byed cing / /gzhal med bsod nams myur du bsdus pa'i zhing / /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /ji snyed sangs rgyas zhing ni bye ba phrag /'di snyed khyab ces tshad dang bral ba yi/ /dpag med 'od zer sna tshogs 'gyed mdzad pa/ /'od dpag med pa'i drung du skye bar shog /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun gyis mgrin gcig tu/ /gang gi mtshan mchog bsngags pa mtha' yas pa/ /rgya chen 'khor gyi dbus su sgrog mdzad pa'i/ /'od dpag med pa'i drung du skye bar shog /gang gi smon lam mthu las sku tshe'i tshad/ /bskal pa bye ba phrag khrig brgya stong du/ /bgrang yas mthar phyin rtogs par mi nus pa'i/ /'od dpag med pa'i drung du skye bar shog /byang chub bar du rigs bzang skye ba dang / /tshangs spyod byang chub spyod la dga' ba dag /gang gi mtshan thos mod las thob 'gyur ba'i/ /'od dpag med pa'i drung du skye bar shog /phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' su yang rung / /byang chub mchog las phyir mi ldog pa nyid/ /gang gi mtshan thos mod la thob 'gyur ba'i/ /'od dpag med pa'i drung du skye bar shog /rgyal ba'i sras rnams bzod pa rnam gsum dang / /sangs rgyas chos las phyir ldog mi 'gyur ba/ /gang gi mtshan thos mod la thob 'gyur ba'i/ /'od dpag med pa'i drung du skye bar shog /gang la gnas na skad cig sangs rgyas nyid/ /grangs med mthong ba'i ting 'dzin rnam phye ba/ /gang gi mtshan thos mod la thob 'gyur ba'i/ /'od dpag med pa'i drung du skye bar shog /skad cig tsam gyis sangs rgyas rnams mchod pa'i/ /kun gyi rjes su song ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ /gang gi mtshan thos mod la thob 'gyur ba'i/ /'od dpag med pa'i drung du skye bar shog /byang chub spyod tshe lhar bcas 'jig rten kun/ /bsti stangs mchog rnams legs par bgyid pa dag

/gang gi mtshan thos mod la thob 'gyur ba'i/ /'od dpag med pa'i drung du skye bar shog /gang zhig smon lam dbang ni ma gtogs pa/ /'tshang rgyar skye ba gcig gis thogs pa nyid/ /gang gi mtshan thos mod la thob 'gyur ba'i/ /'od dpag med pa'i drung du skye bar shog /byang chub sems bskyed bud med su yang rung / /bud med lus kyi tha mar gyur pa dag /gang gi mtshan thos mod la thob 'gyur ba'i/ /'od dpag med pa'i drung du skye bar shog /rgyal ba 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal po'i drung / /dge slong chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya bas/ /sangs rgyas zhing gi bkod pa bzung ba ltar/ /snod bcud dag pa'i zhing bzang thob par shog /'od dpag med mgon khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /sku tshe'i tshad dang 'od kyi khyad par dang / /zhing gi bkod pa'i yod tan ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag kyang 'gyur bar shog /gdul dka' ma dag zhing gi 'gro ba rnams/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i thabs kyis legs drangs te/ /ma nor byang chub bgrod pa'i lam bstan nas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes mchog la 'god par shog /bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs dang / /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rje byin rlabs dang / /'od dpag med mgon thugs bskyed rgya mtsho'i mthus/ /smon lam 'di dag ma lus 'grub par shog /ces zhing mchog bde ba can du skye bar 'dun pa'i smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa zhing gi bkod pa rab tu gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba 'di yang khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po grub pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang / rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sems dpa' chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa chos med snyoms las mkhan za nyal 'chag gi rnal 'byor pa sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mkhas pa snga ma dag gi gsung rab la brten nas legs par sbyar ba 'dis bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 'di dang phyi ma'i don thams cad yid la re ba bzhin 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig/

//sarba maṅgalaṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ zhing mchog bde ba can du skye bar 'dun pa'i smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
